title: Substitute
text: Let $$u=e^x$$, so $$du=e^x dx$$. An antiderivative is $$\arctan\left(e^x\right)$$.

title: Take the limits
text: As $$x$$ goes to $$\infty$$, $$\arctan\left(e^x\right)$$ approaches $$\frac{\pi}{2}$$. As $$x$$ goes to negative $$\infty$$, it approaches $$arctan(0)=0$$. So the integral is $$\frac{\pi}{2}$$.
